title: test_database_financial_ledger_balance_consistency
description: Verify database persistence and mathematical consistency for cash ledger: record an income transaction, verify balance recalculates accurately in the database, and verify cleanup rollback returns balance to baseline.

title: test_database_jemaah_relational_integrity_and_validation
description: Verify database schema validation and persistence integrity for jemaah records: ensure valid jemaah data persists with correct types, and invalid schema inputs are rejected without corrupting database state.

title: test_database_work_program_lifecycle_and_audit_trail
description: Verify database consistency across work program status transitions (Direncanakan -> Sedang Berjalan) and ensure corresponding audit trail records are created.

title: test_database_ziswaf_calculation_and_inventory_consistency
description: Verify database consistency for ZISWAF and mosque inventory items: ensure quantities, categories, and values remain mathematically consistent across reads.

title: test_database_settings_and_profile_persistence
description: Verify that mosque configuration, bank account data, and organization profile persist consistently across server requests and re-reads.
